Original processor 

 1. Ingestion & Initial Routing
   An incoming document arrives at the Ingestor. The ingestor evaluates the document type and routes payload components to three destination paths simultaneously:
   * Text payload \rightarrow Sent directly to Indexer.
   * Binary files \rightarrow Sent to TextExtractor.
   * URLs \rightarrow Sent to WebClipper.
 2. URL Processing (WebClipper Branch)
   The WebClipper fetches external content over the network and returns the retrieved document back to the Ingestor to rejoin the pipeline processing flow.
 3. Extraction (TextExtractor Branch)
   The TextExtractor processes binary content:
   * Success Path: Extracted plain text is sent back to the Ingestor.
   * Failure Path (Extraction Fails): Raw unextracted binary file is dumped into the Raw Repo.
 4. Indexing & Embedding
   The Indexer generates vector embeddings for incoming text streams:
   * Success Path (Indexed): Document metadata and embeddings pass to the Classifier.
   * Failure Path (Not Indexed): Document drops out of classification and routes to the Notes Repo.
 5. Classification & Final Storage
   The Classifier evaluates indexed content, determines topic metadata, and routes the final structured document to the Doc Repo.
